assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The cardiac event monitoring is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmias may be contributing to these embolic events
CPT 93271 supports medical necessity for diagnosis codes G45.9,I34.0,Z86.73
The PR-204 denial states this service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
